description: Retraction feedrates, wipe placement and speed, layer-change gating, and surface-dependent Z-hop contracts.

mutants.description: explicit positive deretraction speeds are emitted, and zero falls back to retraction speed
zero and full retract_before_wipe percentages select distinct emitted placement
full retract_after_wipe emits post-wipe retraction while zero does not
retract_lift_above and retract_lift_below gate lazy lift Z moves
wipe-time retraction remains in the during-wipe bucket when configured
all-surfaces retract lift policy permits lifts on the fixture
Each role-based wipe uses the matching extrusion speed, rather than the independent wipe speed.
Top-only lifts cannot occur on intermediate or bottom layers.
